(`opencode.ai/zen/v1/*`) in"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"to your model picker with **no API key**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It is a Host-only cordis plugin. It registers two provider routes on the `llm`
service, decodes all "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"three wire protocols the lane speaks (Chat Completions /

picker."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| 🔑 **No key** | The lane is keyed by a pooled credential, `Authorization: Bearer public`. The plugi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"n holds no secret of yours, and stores none. |
| 🔀 **Three wire protocols** | All three gateway dial"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ects are implemented and decoded into one host block protocol: `/zen/v1/chat/completions` for the fr"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ee roster, `/zen/v1/responses` for `muse-spark-*`, `/zen/v1/messages` for `union-alpha`. (Routing is"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" by model id, and a model the upstream withdraws simply stops being advertised — `union-alpha` and t"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"he `-contributor-free` Muse Spark ids are in that state today, so every live free model currently ri"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"des the chat wire; the other two mappings still stand for when they return.) |
| 🧭 **Protocol decide"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"d by shape** | The gateway lies in `Content-Type` (a JSON header over an SSE body is a real producti"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"on incident). The verdict comes from the body's own shape, and the bytes spent sniffing it are repla"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"yed — not one token is buffered. |
| 🖐 **The fingerprint tool gate** | The free tier refuses a reque"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"st body that does not declare a tool named exactly `read` (403 `FreeTierError`). The plugin declares"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" that one, plus `bash/glob/grep` for a wider footprint, filling a missing slot by promoting a real t"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"ool that can answer for it (`pwsh`→`bash` on Windows) before it is faked, and the response side rest"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ores the caller's own spelling. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Compatibility & permissions"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **Profiles** | Any profile that mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` — verified on `desktop` and `web`. H"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ost half only: no `dsh.client` declaration, no browser code. |
| **Platform** | Anywhere Node runs. "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"Pure ESM, no native modules, no build step, no runtime dependencies. |
| **Runtime** | Node `^22.15."},{"id":"p11s4","text":"0 || >=24.0.0` (the `engines.node` range). |
| **DSH version** | Built and tested against DeepSeek H"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"arness `0.2.0-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately *not* declared: only that one line has actually b"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"een exercised, and a SemVer range would claim more than has been verified. |
| **Credentials** | Non"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"e. The lane is a public key-free allowance, so the plugin holds no secret and reads none — it never "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"touches the credential service. |
| **Registers** | Two `llm` provider routes. It adds no tools, no "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"commands, no slash commands, no keyboard shortcuts and no client UI. |
| **Writes** | Only under `$D"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"SH_HOME/opencode-free-model/` — `runtime.json`, `catalog.json`, `availability.json`, each written at"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"omically. Nothing outside that directory. |
| **Reads** | Your own attached images, and only to inli"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ne one into a request the model is already answering (through the optional `attachments` service; if"},{"id":"p11s13","text":" it is absent, image blocks fall back to the text projection the runtime already performs). |
| **Ou"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"tbound hosts** | `opencode.ai` — inference and model listing, the only destination your prompts reac"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"h — plus `api.ipify.org` / `ipinfo.io` / `ipapi.co`, which are read once to learn this machine's pub"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"lic IP and country so the plugin knows whether a re-probe is needed. Details in Upstream. |
| **Tele"},{"id":"p11s17","text":"metry** | None. Nothing is reported anywhere except the request itself. |
| **Category** | Models & "},{"id":"p11s18","text":"ne. Nothing is reported anywhere except the request itself. |
| **Category** | Models & Reasoning. |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## What it looks like"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The picker groups, exactly as the plugin advertises them (alphabetical, as
described under Routes):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"`Jev 1.13` is on the upstream listing but serves no wire — every protocol answers
`400 ModelProtocol"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"Unsupported` — so it is left out of the seed and the first

the table, which is only ever consulted for an id the gateway actually named."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"And one real streamed turn, captured against the live lane — note the disjoint

`prompt_tokens` does not give you. This capture had n"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"o cache hit, so the field is
absent rather than zero."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"A stamp is only metered when it can be true. The harness soft-budgets from the
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **`GenerateOptions` sampling is `temperature` / `maxTokens` / `stop` plus
`reasoningEffort`**, and"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" the lane honours the output ceiling and the thinking
level. They are independent: the level control"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"s how much the model thinks, the
ceiling bounds thinking *and* answer together.
- **The thinking men"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"u is per model**, because the gateway validates the value and
the accepted sets genuinely differ (`b"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ig-pickle` refuses `minimal`/`xhigh`;
`space-bunny-free`, when it returns to the roster, refuses `no"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ne`). A rung the
model does not declare is substituted with that model's default rather than
sent.
-"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" **Region verdicts require probing**: the gateway does not disclose which models
your egress may use"},{"id":"p21s8","text":", so the plugin has to ask.
- **The probe period is read at mount time**: changing `probeIntervalMin"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"utes`
needs a plugin reload to take effect.
- **The lane's gate is not a published contract**: the s"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ession-id shape and the
refused User-Agent token were established by measurement, not documentation,"},{"id":"p21s11","text":" so
the gateway can tighten them again without notice. When it does, every turn
fails with `FreeTier"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"Error` surfaced as `CLIENT_ERROR` and `fingerprintRejected:
true` — that is the signal to look for a"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"n update, not to re-authenticate.
